The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as <Subject 2> (S1), in a flat, hollow, disconnected voice, says <d>[English] This sample goes to Raccoon City Hospital. Don't open it.</d> She extends a sealed translucent specimen vial toward him without expression, and <Subject 1> (S2), his jaw tightening, answers quietly with dull resignation <d>[English] Raccoon City. The camera holds on his back as he steps through the door into the dim hallway beyond and the video ends.
